big: Gold is mostly held. Silver is mostly used. More than half of all silver demand comes from factories making solar panels, electronics and batteries. That makes it a metal with two lives.

lines: No. Silver is a precious metal, but over half of its demand is industrial. It swings far more than gold. And traders watch the gold-silver ratio to judge whether silver looks cheap or dear next to gold.
